name: Window List NG
description:
Display a window list at the bottom of the screen.

Optional features:
- Window List itself
- Bottom Overview: overview appears when hovering the bottom of any monitor.
- Panel Free: hide top panel except in overview.
- Light Style: switch default to light style.

Based on Window List and Light Style (official GNOME extensions, @fmuellner) and on the Bottom Overview and Panel Free extensions (@fthx).

These extensions were written by hand, tested by hand, then hardened and integrated with the help of Claude Code.
